title: Stability and strong convergence for complex Hessian equations with $L^1$ data
summary: We study complex $m$-Hessian equations on bounded hyperconvex domains with right-hand side in $L^1(Ω)$. The main contribution of this paper is a strong stability result for weak solutions in the Hessian energy sense. More precisely, if $f_j \to f$ in $L^1(Ω)$ and $u_j, u$ are the corresponding solutions, then \[ \int_Ω|u_j-u|\, H_m(u_j) \longrightarrow 0. \] This provides convergence in the natural energy topology associated to the Hessian operator, which is significantly stronger than convergence in capacity.
